digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill — defect attribution and Phase 1 exit gate
propositions: rebar-debug skill closes bugs without recording the originating ticket that introduced the defect, making defect escape rate unmeasurable

The fallback blame derivation (blame.py:184-227) attributes defects to whoever wrote most of the file rather than whoever introduced the defect, and cannot detect when fix site differs from cause site (unmet obligations, missed consumer updates)
Phase 1 Stage 3 exit gate must require explicit attribution of defects to their originating tickets before RCA writeback, using --caused-by flag on close
The skill must detect fix-site-is-not-cause-site cases via date testing and producer-side history search to identify unmet obligations and missed consumer updates
Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees with `make worktree name=<branch>` and run commands with worktree venv on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
